release_notes: LeadForge tracker destinations & UI fixes. The LeadForge build panel gains a Tracker destination selector: save each bundle as a local lander (Landings), a direct local offer (Offers — is_local with files served from the tracker itself, no landing record), or the linked lander+offer pair; an explicit "ZIP only" state replaces the old auto-save checkboxes. Groups follow the destination (landing groups vs offer groups) and can be created on the fly right in the panel — a duplicate name now selects the existing group instead of erroring. The matching offer is linked to a same-named offer group instead of a landing-group id, fixing an FK failure when building with a group selected. The default payout is opt-in: nothing is hardcoded into the landing unless "Fixed payout" is checked, so real revenue comes from the network's S2S postback. The date-range calendar no longer runs off-screen when its trigger sits at the left edge of a toolbar (Landings): it measures the viewport and opens to the side that actually fits. Facebook 1-Click OAuth shows a preflight warning and disables the button when no Meta app is configured, plus a where-to-get-a-token hint. PHP landings are now enabled by default (LeadForge bundles live on order.php) with the toggle and timeout exposed in Settings → General.
